shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "pwd && rg --files -g 'AGENTS.md' -g '"'!node_modules'"' -g '"'!**/.git/**'"' && rg --files app src pages components | head -100"
/bin/bash -lc 'cat lib/data.ts && cat next.config.ts && cat node_modules/next/package.json | head -45'
/bin/bash -lc "find node_modules/next -maxdepth 4 -type d | head -80 && rg --files node_modules/next | rg 'docs|prefetch|navigation' | head -100"

/bin/bash -lc "find node_modules/next -type f \\( -iname '*prefetch*.md' -o -iname '*link*.md' -o -iname '*cache*.md' \\) | head -100; find /workspace -path '*/next/dist/docs/*' -maxdepth 10 -type f | head -30"
/bin/bash -lc "rg -n -F \"'use cache'\" node_modules/next/dist/server/use-cache -g '*.js' | head -30; rg -n -F 'PPRRuntime' node_modules/next/dist/server -g '*.js' | head -30"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n -F 'useCache' node_modules/next/dist/server/config-shared.d.ts node_modules/next/dist/server/config-shared.js node_modules/next/dist/server/config-schema.js node_modules/next/dist/server/config.js | head -60; rg -n -F 'ppr' node_modules/next/dist/server/config-shared.d.ts | head -35; rg -n -F 'dynamicIO' node_modules/next/dist/server/config-shared.d.ts node_modules/next/dist/server/config-schema.js | head -35"
/bin/bash -lc 'git show HEAD:package.json && git show HEAD:next.config.ts && git show HEAD:app/catalog/page.tsx && cat .gitignore'
/bin/bash -lc 'git diff -- package.json && git status --short && cat next.config.ts'
/bin/bash -lc 'git diff -- app/page.tsx lib/data.ts next.config.ts package.json tsconfig.json && git status --short && head -34 package-lock.json'

/bin/bash -lc "command -v chromium || command -v chromium-browser || command -v google-chrome || command -v firefox || true; rg -n -F 'Next-Router-Prefetch' node_modules/next/dist/client/components/segment-cache-impl -g '*.js' | head -35"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n -F 'Next-Router-Prefetch' node_modules/next/dist/client -g '*.js' | head -40; rg -n -F 'NEXT_ROUTER_PREFETCH_HEADER' node_modules/next/dist/client -g '*.js' | head -50; rg -n -F 'next-router-segment-prefetch' node_modules/next/dist/client -g '*.js' | head -40"

/bin/bash -lc "curl -sS -D /tmp/catalog-prefetch-headers -o /tmp/catalog-prefetch-sale -H 'RSC: 1' -H 'Next-Router-Prefetch: 2' -H 'Next-Router-State-Tree: [\"\",{\"children\":[\"__PAGE__\",{}]}]' -H 'Next-Url: /' 'http://localhost:3100/catalog?category=sale' && head -18 /tmp/catalog-prefetch-headers && rg -o 'Products on sale|Canvas Tote|Travel Mug|Loading category' /tmp/catalog-prefetch-sale | sort -u && wc -c /tmp/catalog-prefetch-sale"

/bin/bash -lc "curl -LsS -D /tmp/catalog-prefetch-headers -o /tmp/catalog-prefetch-sale -H 'RSC: 1' -H 'Next-Router-Prefetch: 2' -H 'Next-Router-State-Tree: [\"\",{\"children\":[\"__PAGE__\",{}]}]' -H 'Next-Url: /' 'http://localhost:3100/catalog?category=sale' && tail -25 /tmp/catalog-prefetch-headers && rg -o 'Products on sale|Canvas Tote|Travel Mug|Loading category' /tmp/catalog-prefetch-sale | sort -u && wc -c /tmp/catalog-prefetch-sale"

/bin/bash -lc "curl -LsS -o /tmp/catalog-prefetch-featured -H 'RSC: 1' -H 'Next-Router-Prefetch: 2' -H 'Next-Router-State-Tree: [\"\",{\"children\":[\"__PAGE__\",{}]}]' -H 'Next-Url: /' 'http://localhost:3100/catalog?category=featured' && rg -o 'Featured products|Desk Lamp|Wool Blanket|Canvas Tote|Travel Mug' /tmp/catalog-prefetch-featured | sort -u && rg -o 'Featured products|Desk Lamp|Wool Blanket|Canvas Tote|Travel Mug' /tmp/catalog-prefetch-sale | sort -u"

/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
build_dir = Path('/workspace/.next')
if build_dir.is_dir() and (build_dir / 'BUILD_ID').is_file():
    shutil.rmtree(build_dir)
else:
    raise SystemExit('Expected generated Next.js build directory was not found')
PY"
/bin/bash -lc 'git diff --check && git diff --stat && git diff -- app/page.tsx lib/data.ts next.config.ts tsconfig.json && git status --short'

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n '\"next\"|\"version\": \"16.4.5\"' package-lock.json | head -12; nl -ba app/page.tsx | sed -n '10,22p'; nl -ba lib/data.ts | sed -n '1,18p'; nl -ba next.config.ts | sed -n '1,12p'"

/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
path = Path('/workspace/next-env.d.ts')
if path.is_file() and path.read_text().startswith('/// <reference types=\"next\" />'):
    path.unlink()
else:
    raise SystemExit('Expected generated Next.js type file was not found')
PY"
